score_spec.source: converted/_pdf/赛道三参赛手册.pdf.md (scoring table, lines ~327-345)
score_spec.negative_correlation_policy: clipped to 0 when forming a score; raw value always reported
score_spec.undefined_slice_policy: NaN (never imputed); excluded from the mean and counted in n_undefined

time_semantics.note: no pert_time value is held out; models may treat pert_time as an ordinal/numeric feature and interpolate within the observed range

batch_confound.finding: mu_ctx is grouped by Strain x Medium x Temperature x Time with no data_source, so it cannot absorb the plate/instrument offset that Step 1 attributed to PC1 (eta-squared 0.94). A group mean conditioned on data_source therefore predicts a real component of the S1/S2 residual while knowing nothing about chemistry.
batch_confound.step3_implication: condition absolute-abundance and Delta models on data_source / instrument: it is worth ~0.45 residual PCC on the 20%-weighted S1 module before any chemistry is modelled.

null_floor.finding: residual PCC is not zero-centred. For a null predictor (Delta_pred == 0) the prediction residual is -mu and the truth residual is Delta_true - mu, which share the -mu term and so correlate positively for free.
null_floor.step3_implication: compare models against the control_anchor floor, not against 0.0; a residual PCC below that floor is worse than predicting no perturbation effect at all.
